units.source_text: 忽闻有人叫道：“小姐回来了！”

en.t: Suddenly he heard someone call out, "The young lady has returned!"

units.source_text: 众侍女手忙脚乱，赶快把帷屏张起来。

en.t: The maids were thrown into confusion and hurriedly set up the curtains and screens.

units.source_text: 夕雾想把这小女公子的相貌和昨日及今晨所窥见的两个如花美眷比较一下。

en.t: Yugiri wanted to compare this young princess's appearance with the two flowerlike beauties he had glimpsed yesterday and that morning.

units.source_text: 他平日不喜欢做此种事情，但今天顾不得了，把上半身钻在边门口的帘子底下，身上披着帘子，从帷屏的隙缝里窥探。

en.t: Ordinarily he disliked doing such things, but today he could not restrain himself; he slipped his upper body beneath the curtain by the side doorway, draped the curtain over himself, and peered through a gap in the screen.

units.source_text: 正好望见小女公子从有遮掩的地方向这边走来，一晃而过。

en.t: He happened to see the young princess come this way from a sheltered place, passing by in a flash.

units.source_text: 因众侍女纷纷来去，不大看得清楚，心甚懊恼。

en.t: Because the maids were bustling back and forth, he could not see her clearly, and he felt deeply frustrated.

units.source_text: 但见小女公子身穿淡紫色衣服，头发还没有长得同身体一样长，末端扩展如扇形。

en.t: He could only make out that the young princess wore pale purple robes, and that her hair had not yet grown as long as her body, its ends spreading out like a fan.

units.source_text: 身材小巧玲珑，教人觉得可爱可怜。

en.t: Her figure was small and delicate, making her seem both lovely and touching.

units.source_text: 夕雾想道：“前年我还能偶然和她见面；现在比起那时来，她长大而美丽得多了。

en.t: Yugiri thought, "The year before last I could still happen to meet her; now, compared with then, she has grown much more beautiful.

units.source_text: 何况将来到了盛年，不知长得多么可爱哩。”

en.t: When she reaches the full bloom of youth in the future, how lovely she will become!"

units.source_text: 倘把以前窥见的紫姬比作樱花，玉鬘比作棣棠，那么这小女公子可说是藤花。

en.t: If the Lady Murasaki he had glimpsed before could be compared to cherry blossoms, and Tamakazura to kerria flowers, then this young princess could be called wisteria.

units.source_text: 藤花开在高高的树梢上，临风摇曳的模样，正可比拟这个人的姿态。

en.t: The sight of wisteria blooming high in the treetops and swaying in the wind was exactly like this person's bearing.

units.source_text: 他想：“我很想随心所欲地和这些美人朝夕相见。

en.t: He thought, "I would very much like to see these beauties morning and evening whenever I please.

units.source_text: 照关系而论，本来是可以的。

en.t: Judging by our relationship, it ought to be possible.

units.source_text: 无奈父亲在处处严加防范，教我好恨啊！”

en.t: But my father keeps strict guard everywhere, and it makes me terribly resentful!"

units.source_text: 他虽然性情忠厚，此时也不免心驰神往了。

en.t: Although he was honest and gentle by nature, at this moment he could not help being carried away by longing.
